Little Sister

PG

You are a newly emerged honeybee on your first day out of the cell. Your sisters all have jobs to do. You want to be useful, but where to start? And you're hungry.

  • From this page: download an edition, then open your Choosatron's Stories tab and drop the file on Drop a story file here. This works even when your Choosatron has no internet connection.
